name: motion-recreate
description: Recreate a reference video (a link or file) as the user's own Motion film: rebuild it as an editable OpenMotion project and hand it over open in the editor, keeping the original content or swapping in the user's copy, brand and assets. This includes small edits to the user's own finished video when no editable project for it exists. "Make one like this" and "I want this feel" both count as recreation. In a workspace with the user's product material, a bare link alone means "make one like this for us". Not for only analysing or discussing a video. Use motion-director when the reference is only inspiration for an original film, motion-template-to-video for an existing template, motion-production for edits to an existing editable OpenMotion project, and motion-video-to-template for a reusable template package.
